about: Literal back-translation of the Brazilian Portuguese storyboard of content/zoora-ai/_engine-demo (snapshot in this folder), made 2026-11-24 by a Claude session (wave 3) for the proof run. NOT blind: this session had read the English storyboard first. Each item keeps the Brazilian Portuguese text it was made from, so a change to the episode shows up as stale.

title.text: Por que a maioria das memecoins novas morre no primeiro dia
title.bt: Why most of the new memecoins die on the first day

s01.narration.text: A maioria das memecoins novas na Pump.fun nunca chega ao segundo dia. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]
s01.narration.bt: Most of the new memecoins on Pump.fun never reach the second day. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]

s01.onScreen.subtitle.text: O que os dados de lançamento mostram

s02.narration.text: A CoinGecko acompanhou 18,67 milhões delas. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] 68,67% fizeram a última negociação na curva de lançamento no primeiro dia. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] Noventa dias depois, só 4,55% ainda eram negociadas. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]
s02.narration.bt: CoinGecko followed/tracked 18.67 million of them. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] 68.67% made the last trade on the launch curve on the first day. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing] Ninety days later, only 4.55% were still traded. [src:cg-cryptonews,cg-cryptobriefing]

s03.narration.text: Veja o primeiro dia de uma moeda inventada. Um lançamento, uma onda de compras, depois uma venda em massa, e uma lenta agonia.
s03.narration.bt: See the first day of an invented coin. A launch, a wave of purchases, then a mass sale, and a slow agony.

s04.narration.text: Antes de mexer numa moeda nova, pergunte: quem detém a oferta? O que mais o criador lançou? E quem é pago para promovê-la?
s04.narration.bt: Before messing with/touching a new coin, ask: who holds the supply? What else did the creator launch? And who is paid to promote it?
